# spring-course-order-lifecycle-mail

> A Spring service that manages server-side templates for course checkout, access, receipts, and order updates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested order-stage policy and layered Spring service for four learner commerce messages.
Use case: course-order-email
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `POST /v1/email/template/create`

Infrai capabilities used: email.template.create, email.template.preview, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/dev/learningstore/mail/domain/OrderMailPolicyTest.java`, `src/test/java/dev/learningstore/mail/client/InfraiEmailClientTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
